source.classification: Full CarLaneSelectIterator non-gizmo methods automatically extracted, original Game structs/PathNode methods and Unity.Mathematics DLL execute. Lookup/Buffer containers replaced with dictionaries/arrays; no Unity World executed. Four scalar methods separately execute original Game.dll by reflection.

extraction.replacement: Lookup/Buffer wrappers are explicit dictionaries; source math and original Game structs unchanged; SetBuffer allocates 96 float[] slots, debug Gizmo methods excluded. ChooseClosestLane body source-extracted for dictionary access; CalculateTransformPosition is an explicit world-position input.
